root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that when ->atomic_create returns an error, “nfsd4_create_file() will pass an error pointer to end_creating() and the parent will not be unlocked,” and the patch fixes this by preserving orig_dentry with dget()/dput() and restoring it when atomic_open() returns IS_ERR(dentry) so “path->dentry is always a valid dentry, never an error-pointer.”
